name: Project Plan
goal: A project plan contains the details about the project itself and contains a timeline of how the project will be developed. It also contains risks, research questions, and a testing strategy. In summary, it is an overview of the project.

approach.text: I looked up templates from previous projects that haven been approved. I also looked at previous research documents to come up with research questions for this project.

result: The project plan is can be seen here: <<document Project Plan.docx>>
validation: I discussed the plan with my semester coach, who gave me some questions to consider, such as for what purpose I want to research audio design but got approved overall.
contribution: The project plan contributes to the management of the project, as it adds a structured overview of the project.
